visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two individuals, a woman with long highlighted brown hair and a man in a white sleeveless shirt, are seen in a medium close-up shot. The woman smiles broadly while looking at the camera, her facial expressions showing excitement. They are located in an indoor home environment with soft lighting and a neutral-colored curtain in the background. (2) The woman holds up a smartphone toward the camera lens, displaying a vertical social media video of a couple performing a high-energy dance lift in an urban street setting. The camera focuses on the phone screen while the man observes from the background with a skeptical squint and his mouth slightly agape. (3) The camera angle shifts to a full shot in the living room area. The woman stands in the center, wearing a khaki-colored graphic t-shirt and wide-leg denim jeans. She begins to perform exaggerated dance movements and spins, while the man stands to the right, watching her preparations in a cluttered kitchen-living space with a vacuum cleaner visible. (4) The man approaches and attempts to perform the lift seen in the video. As the woman spins into his arms, he lifts her off the ground and spins. The physical exertion is evident in his facial strain. Large white text overlays with English song lyrics appear dynamically on the screen, centered over the couple. (5) The couple stops the movement, and the scene shifts to a medium shot. The woman is laughing hysterically but clutching her left elbow, suggesting a minor impact or strain. The man stands in the background, grimacing and holding his lower back with both hands, indicating physical discomfort from the lift attempt while smiling through the pain.
